purpose: Reduce administrative/low-information announcement downloads without using document contents or future returns.
inputs: candidate metadata from the frozen July-2023 documentary metadata probe only
inclusion_rules: retain any candidate with runway, moat or orders keyword-family metadata
retain optionality candidate only if it has a specific optionality term other than generic approval or qualification, unless it also qualifies through a high-information subject
retain Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
retain Annual Report when identifiable from subject or attachment filename
tie_break: latest known_at first, then subject lexicographically
scoring_effect: NONE; triage only controls which source documents are downloaded first. A non-downloaded document cannot create a score, and no feature/rubric threshold is changed.
review_effect: All extracted claims remain candidate-only until approved under documentary_forward_evidence_rubric_v1.json.
